negative_controls: Same path, symlink and hardlink are never independent capture files
Zero samples from both JSON captures raise ValueError, not a false match
Bounded exact size binary, actual all-three site coverage and duplicate invocation checks
Strict schema, duplicate manifest keys, invalid SHA256, oversized manifest
Reference must be declared original_spirv and candidate declared hlsl_roundtrip_spirv or unity_compute_spirv
Declared input and dispatch SHA256 must agree across stages, individual trace digest must equal actual capture bytes
Changed read coordinate and value produce nonmatch; true independent files with equal output may match

budget: 4-minute Ubuntu-24.04 source-free synthetic tests only, no GPU, no game asset staging
rejected_hypotheses: Identical file used twice supplies independent shader parity evidence: new gate rejects same inode, symlink and hardlink as not independent.
Two empty sample maps are evidence of match: now reject empty-both captures explicitly.

limitations: Declared shader/dispatch/input digests are required and compared, but unsigned metadata cannot authenticate actual capture-producing shader, GPU or runner. External SHA-linked CI stage is necessary.

No shader changes, original assets or Android build in this scoped work.
